Together, they share the joys and frustrations of birdwatching as well as the pure exhilaration in spotting a bird that means so much to them. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

Scientists are exploring the deep past embedded in South African and Australian rocks, the surface of the moon, asteroid dust taken from space and ancient impact craters to develop a revolutionary new theory that suggests these violent collisions may have provided the essential ingredients – water, minerals and energy – needed for life to ignite on our planet. Could the very objects once thought to extinguish life have actually sparked it?
